texts.label: R24, Brussels 9 Oct 1721
texts.summary: An unsigned slip headed Brussels 9 Oct 1721, probably from the internuncio at Brussels (Austrian Netherlands) to the nuncio at Cologne: news wanted of a suspended parish priest and of a person at Tournai, the Cologne affair, and an offer to write to a correspondent of the recipient, awaiting orders. READING.md is the project's reading with three key values added; the two DECODE files are Lasry's segmented decryption (2020) and Bonavoglia's reading with translation, kept for comparison.

reading_review.note: v5 check 23 Oct 2026: listed as Spanish, the slip is Italian (1721), so the plain share is a bar too. The sweep scored Bonavoglia's DECODE file DOC_R24_D3443 (reading, '?' marks and English together: plain 0.308, explicit 1.0). The project's reading READING.md (Lasry's key plus three values) now has a '## Reading' heading and is the entry's reading: plain 0.667 (2/3), explicit 0.667 (2/3), hole rate 0.138. The two later sentences hold; the first ('Sopra il curato [45] [9441] [43]te divinis, g(rat)s(?) di sapere qualche cosa di [9336] [9485] di Tournai') carries the three open nomenclator codes. A nine-line slip; keeps read, the open codes having no key material (Lasry's key leaves them blank).

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 86.0% of the words of READING.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.
